# pvecli vm ssh

SSH into a VM (IP resolved via QEMU Guest Agent).

```text
pvecli vm ssh [VMID] [OPTIONS]
```

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `VMID` | VM ID. |

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-u`, `--user VALUE` | SSH user. |
| `-P`, `--port N` | SSH port. |
| `-i`, `--key VALUE` | Path to SSH key. |
| `-j`, `--jump` | Use node as jump host. |
| `-c`, `--command VALUE` | Execute command instead of shell. |
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
